meta.name: screen_elements
meta.description: 231 (plan stage A, A4; DECISIONS 231): the screen elements a process pack's tabs are built from. A shared element is one any process may use; a special element is registered once (with the capability whose step it shows) and from then on any process may use it too. A process pack naming an element not listed here is refused (jav/app/process_packs.py). The interface renders each type with one component (A6). Stage D0 (D0-a): an element with "status": "planned" is listed before it is built (the interface has no component for it and no capability gives its data); no pack may use it until it is built.

changelog.note: 231 (A4): the first set: the shared elements of the process packs and the three special elements of the quote's back half.
231 (A7e): the send step's handovers and the reply step's wait as special elements; the timeline and the cost shared elements get their data.
231 (B1): the partner link, a shared element: the partners a case is about, linked or proposed from its record.

231 (C1c): the file routing, a special element (the email packages, the decisions to make and what went where), and the started cases, a shared element: the cases started from an item of the packages a case reads.

231 (C3b3): the package work, a special element: the processing package a document processing step made (its items and runs), its live run's start with the cost cap and the way to the package's own processing, review and result.

231 (C2d): the pairing, a special element (the invoices and the statements the scope takes, the decisions on the pairs and the approved statement), the reconciliation package's three stages until now; (C2c) the AI pairing proposal, a special element (the button with the run's cap, the run's state and what it answered).

231 (stage D0, D0-a): the six shared elements the interface has no component for yet (data table, field review, form, document view, blockers, actions) are marked planned, so a pack cannot use them and get an empty tab; the approval is the line composition's special element, as only its step gives its data (stage D0, D0-d makes it shared).

231 (stage D0, D0-d): the approval is shared again, for every step that approves a version of its own: its state (missing, approved, out of date, returned), its versions, and the step's domain's own approval in it where there is one.

231 (stage D, D-f4): the field review is built (for a field check's step: its units and their sources, the disagreements a person settles, the freeze with the day cover starts), and two special elements: the facts a step read from its documents (document_facts) and an outside register's question and answer (lookup).
231 (stage D, D-f5): three special elements: a rule evaluation (evaluation), a premium's computation (calculation), each with its versions, and the wait for missing facts (missing_info).
231 (stage D, D-f6): a person's decision on another step's result (decision): the choices, the second person above a limit, the decision that holds, and its state.
231 (stage D, D-f7): the document view is built, for a step that prints a priced document: the file stored with the version it printed, its fingerprint and its download.
231 (stage D, D-f8): a letter that goes with a printed document (letter): the draft from its frame, a person's changes and acceptance, the accepted letter's email file.

231 (stage D, D-f9): the blockers are built: what holds an open case (a step that stopped or must run again, one waiting for a person's start or decision, one waiting for something else), each with the tab where it is resolved.

data_table.what: A table from a registered dataset (columns, filters and links from the service).

field_review.what: A record's fields with their source on the page, each checked or corrected by a person: a field check's units and the facts offered for them, the disagreements a person settles, and the freeze.

form.what: A step's own form, from its capability's description.

document_view.what: A step's document: the file a priced document's step printed and stored with the version it printed, its fingerprint and its download (its pages are planned).

approval.what: The approval of a step that approves a version of its own: its state (missing, approved, out of date, returned with a reason), its versions, and the step's own approval when its domain shows one (the quote's lines and Word document).

blockers.what: What holds an open case, step by step: a step that stopped or must run again, one waiting for a person's start or decision, one waiting for something else, each with the tab where it is resolved.

actions.what: The step's actions, each with its cost cap when it may spend.

timeline.what: The case's events in order: who did what and when.

cost.what: What the case's steps spent, by step and service.

partner_link.what: The partners a case is about, by its pack's partner links: linked, or proposed from its record with the partner they seem to be.

record_view.what: A record put together from its parts, with the part each value came from and its gaps.

match_proposal.what: Each requested item's proposed catalogue item: sure, to check or not listed.

line_editor.what: The lines a person composes from the match, priced by code, with own prices and notes.

letter.what: A letter that goes with a printed document: the draft from its frame with the document's values, the address, the subject and the text a person changes and accepts, the document it attaches, and the accepted letter's email file.

handover_view.what: What a send step sent: its mode, each attempt's file, recipient and outcome, and whether a person must say it arrived.

reply_wait.what: A reply step's wait: since when, when the follow-up opens, and the reply recorded.

started_cases.what: The cases started from an item of the work packages the case reads, each with its process and state.

file_placement.what: The routing of emailed documents: the email packages (show: sources), the decisions to make (show: decide) or what went where (show: routed).

pairing.what: The pairing of two lists: the invoices the scope takes (show: invoices), its statements with the scope and the coverage (show: lines), the decisions on the pairs (show: decide) or the approved statement (show: result).

package_work.what: The processing package a document processing step made: its items and runs, the start of its live run with the cost cap, and the way to its own processing, review and result.

pairing_proposal.what: The AI pairing proposal a person starts: its button with the run's cost cap, the run's state, how many lines it answered and what it spent.

document_facts.what: The facts a step read from a case's documents: each document with how many it gave and what it could not read, with why.

evaluation.what: A rule evaluation: its verdict, the facts it missed, its blockers, each unit's outcomes with the rules that gave them, and its earlier versions.

calculation.what: A premium's computation from its tariff: each line with its basis and factors, the modules' minimums, the total, what blocks it, and its earlier versions.

missing_info.what: The wait for missing facts: what is missing, the task's deadline or how it ended, and saying with a reason that they will not come.

decision.what: A person's decision on another step's result: what it decides on, the choices the result allows, whether another person decides above a limit, the decision that holds, and its state when it is missing, out of date or returned.

lookup.what: An outside register's question and answer: what it was asked with, the facts it offers, or why it was not asked or did not answer.
